div.div: This part is just for profile, where you can view things that are specific to your profile (e.g reservations, details, etc)
If you are an entrant this displays your reservations, if you are a camp site owner this displays the reservations at your campsite(s), if you are an admin this displays all reservations.
You can also cancel a reservation inside the profile
